items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And they had Billy Taylor. No, wasn't Billy Taylor -- Cy St. Clair was on bass, playing bass tuba.

ctx.x: Yes, uh-huh, Tommy Ladnier; Benny Carter was on alto. Let me see now. Who else was there? Benny Waters was there, but he had -- he left on account of he had an operation for his tonsils, and they came after me to play. And they had Billy Taylor. No, wasn't Billy Taylor -- Cy St. Clair was on bass, playing bass tuba.
Well, that's interesting, what you said about Tommy. (He Doesn't he have that (unintelligible)?
